info.name: Atlas API - Multi-Market Real Estate Intelligence
info.description:
REST API for Atlas, a multi-market real estate intelligence platform covering Yerevan, Baku and Tbilisi.

Setup:
1. Set base_url to http://localhost:8080 (local) or your VPS URL
2. Set market to yerevan, baku or tbilisi (default: yerevan)
3. Create an API token at /yerevan/admin/tokens
4. Paste the token into the token variable

All authenticated endpoints require: Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

Market-aware endpoints: pass ?market={{market}} to scope results to the selected market.

Thread 14 additions: /api/v1/trends/volume and /api/v1/trends/price for time-series trend charts.

variable.description: Base URL - change to your VPS URL when deployed
Sanctum API token - create one at /admin/tokens in the dashboard

Scraper source key for Yerevan. Options: listam_apartments_sale, listam_apartments_rent, listam_houses_sale, listam_commercial_sale, listam_commercial_rent, listam_land_sale, listam_new_developments_sale
Active market. Options: yerevan, baku, tbilisi. Use global in AI chat body for cross-market context.

item.name: Public (no auth needed)
item.description: Endpoints accessible without any token. These power Screen 0 - the public market snapshot.

request.description: Check if the application is running. No auth required.

Returns headline stats for all 7 property categories: median price/sqm, total listing count and deal type (sale/rent). Powers the public Screen 0 page. No auth required.

Pass ?market=yerevan (or baku/tbilisi) to scope to a specific market.

item.name: Scraper Control
item.description: Start, stop and monitor scrape runs. All endpoints require a Bearer token.

request.description: Start a scrape run for one category. pages defaults to 1 if omitted. Returns the run_id.
Start a scrape run for all 7 categories at once using the same page count. Categories already running are skipped automatically.
Get the latest run state for one category. States: pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled.
Get the latest run state for all 7 categories at once, including live total listing counts. Used by the dashboard polling loop.

Returns a time-series of completed scrape runs for one category grouped by date. Each point includes new_listings (added that day) and cumulative_listings (running total). Powers the trend chart on the dashboard.
Cancel a specific scrape run by ID. Note: this updates the DB state only - jobs already queued in Redis may still execute. Use horizon:clear to fully stop queued work.
Cancel all currently running scrape runs.

item.name: Listings & Market Data
item.description: Query scraped listing data and market statistics.

request.description: Paginated list of scraped listings for a category. Filter by district, price range, rooms and area. All filters are optional.
Returns average and median price/sqm per district for a category, plus price reduction count per district in the last 7 days. Powers the Market Stats page. Results cached 1 hour.
Returns a one-paragraph AI-generated market summary for a category, based on real scraped data. Cached 6 hours. Cache clears automatically when a new scrape completes.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Property pair to calculate yield for. Options: residential (apartments sale vs rent), commercial (commercial sale vs rent)

request.description: Returns estimated gross rental yield per district. Yield = (rent_median * 12) / sale_median * 100. Only shown for districts with at least 5 listings on both the sale and rent side. Currently shown on Market Stats for Commercial for Sale only.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Filter by bill of sale: true or false (optional, bina.az only)
Filter by mortgage availability: true or false (optional, bina.az only)
Exclude probable duplicates (same plot, multiple agencies). Default true.
Filter by listing date from YYYY-MM-DD (optional)
Filter by listing date to YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

request.description: Filter listings by multiple criteria for the Data Hub page. Not rate-limited — safe for UI polling. Supports: source, district, status[], min/max price, min/max area, rooms[], agency, scraped_from/to.

Returns monthly or quarterly listing volume for a market, split by listing_type (sale/rent). Powers the Market Stats trend charts.

Uses listing_date (when seller posted) not scraped_at — reflects real market activity.

GroupBy options: month (default), quarter. Year support deferred until sufficient historical data.

Returns monthly or quarterly median sale price/sqm for a market. Sale listings only — rent price/sqm on the same axis as sale is misleading.

Uses PostgreSQL percentile_cont(0.5) for true median (not average). All prices in USD.

item.name: Exports
item.description: Download scraped data as Excel files.

request.description: Download an Excel export for one category. Returns the .xlsx file directly. Generates from the current full DB dataset, not scoped to any single run. Apartments and Rentals include a 5-sheet market report; other categories include a single raw listings sheet.
Download all 7 category exports in a single zip file. Returns a .zip containing one .xlsx per category.

query.description: Filter by bill of sale: true or false (optional, bina.az only)
Filter by mortgage availability: true or false (optional, bina.az only)
Exclude probable duplicates (same plot, multiple agencies). Default true.
Filter by listing date from YYYY-MM-DD (optional)
Filter by listing date to YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

request.description: Generate and download a filtered Excel export from the Data Hub. Accepts the same filter params as /listings/filter. Returns a single-sheet .xlsx file with all matching listings. Not rate-limited.

item.name: AI Assistant
item.description: AI assistant endpoints. All require a Bearer token. Supports per-market (pass market in body) and global context (market='global' — queries all markets). 9 callable tools including compareMarkets for cross-market comparison.

request.description: Check if the AI provider is reachable and responding.
Send a message to the AI assistant. The market field scopes responses to the selected market. History is stored per user per market.

response.name: 200 OK
429 Rate limited

request.description: Fetch the last 20 AI chat messages for the current user, scoped to the selected market. History is stored separately per user per market.
Returns the current user's token usage and cost for this month and all time.
Returns system-wide token usage and cost for this month and all time. Admin and super_admin only.
Submit thumbs up or down feedback on an AI response. vote must be 'up' or 'down'.
Receive webhook events from external systems. Requests must be signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the WEBHOOK_SECRET from .env. No Bearer token required - signature verification replaces auth.
